name: Switchroom lighting-contact relay interface
aliases: switchrooms Switchroom lighting and access interfaces
summary: Links the lighting-control relay to the power contacts serving the selected branch.
description: Links the lighting-control relay to the power contacts serving the selected branch. Lighting and access interfaces coordinate the electrical-room service circuits and their supervision. Normal lighting, emergency illumination and access indication have different power sources and purposes.

In a switchroom, a normal lighting branch may be switched locally while the specified emergency luminaires remain connected to their own backed-up or integral supply. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Lighting relay command” at the input and “Lighting contact operation” at the output. Contact rating depends on the actual lighting load.
